issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant duplicated between Python and TypeScript, violating single-source-of-truth.
issues.detail: The literal 'python:3.12' now appears in pipeline.py, CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and as a fallback in Commands.ts. The whole point of the RPC get_default_base_image is to centralize this; the TS-side constant defeats that invariant. When Python bumps to 3.13, three files drift. Keep one authoritative source and treat the RPC failure path as an explicit error, not a silent literal.

issues.description: Semantic change to _set_base_image alters compiled output for users relying on prior empty-string behavior.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' caused the template to fall through to 'base_image or "python:3.12"'; now it is pinned to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE at pipeline-config time. These are not equivalent when an outer base_image is passed to the template: the old code let the outer value win, the new code shadows it. State the invariant: which layer owns the default? Audit the precedence chain end-to-end.

issues.description: Button width 5% with text 'IMAGE' is a layout claim without measurement.
issues.detail: Setting style width:'5%' on a Button containing the word IMAGE will either overflow or truncate at common panel widths. The author has substituted intuition for measurement. Either size to content or measure the actual rendered width across the panel's resize range before committing to a percentage.

issues.description: Missing literate comment on precedence rule baseImage → pipelineBaseImage → defaultBaseImage → hardcoded.
issues.detail: createBaseImageText encodes a four-level fallback chain that is now load-bearing for what users see. A careful reader cannot reconstruct the invariant from the code alone: why does pipelineBaseImage sit between step and default? Add one paragraph stating the precedence and where each value originates. This is exactly the non-obvious code that wants a literate comment.

issues.description: Synchronous RPC call on every panel activation without caching.
issues.detail: getDefaultBaseImage is awaited inside activate() alongside getKfpUiHost, but the default base image is effectively a constant for the session. Each notebook open pays an RPC round trip for a value that will not change. Not in the critical 3%, but trivially cacheable at module scope; flagging as info, not asking for premature optimization elsewhere.

review.summary: The feature is small and the intent is sound, but the implementation breaks the single-source-of-truth invariant it set out to establish: 'python:3.12' is now hardcoded in at least three places, and the RPC indirection is undermined by TS-side fallbacks. The change to _set_base_image (empty string to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE) is a semantic shift in the template precedence chain that deserves an explicit invariant statement and audit. The UI precedence rule (step → pipeline → default → literal) is non-obvious and needs a literate-programming-grade comment. Decision: UNDER-AUDITED with NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT. Centralize the default, document the precedence, and the rest is fine.
